== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|A Sylvan is a type of natural spirit formed from the accumulation of [[vital aura]] in environments where that energy is exceptionally powerful and perfectly balanced. Unlike [[Remnants]], which result from the passing of a [[sacred artist]], Sylvans are born naturally. Different types of Sylvans exist depending on the specific aspects of the local aura; for example, [[Dreamseeds]] emerge from areas influenced by [[dream aura]]. A specific variety known as the [[Sylvan Riverseed]] is characterized by its gentle and versatile nature, possessing a water-like aspect. These spirits appear as tiny, finger-sized humanoid figures composed of flowing blue waves or [[madra]] that mimics water. [[Riverseeds]] are capable of supporting and supplementing various types of power, making them useful for balancing opposing forces, such as the corrosive nature of [[Blackflame]]. They exhibit curious, social, and expressive behaviors, communicating through sounds resembling musical instruments like flutes, bells, or wind chimes. They can be nourished with [[madra]] or [[scales]] to increase their solidity and color, which ranges from a pale, translucent state to a deeper blue.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|This tiny spirit possesses a translucent blue form. Flowing [[madra]] in her lower half creates the appearance of a dress.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Sylvan is a spirit who has only ever interacted with [[Lindon]].}}
